title: The Red Line
synopsis:
Three women fall prey to a
                                                ruthless phone scam. To settle
                                                the score, they'll take on the
                                                criminal network that stole
                                                their money and their dignity.

title: The Medium
synopsis:
A horrifying story of a shaman's
                                                inheritance in the Isan region
                                                of Thailand. What could be
                                                possessing a family member might
                                                not be the Goddess they make it
                                                out to be.

title: A Useful Ghost
synopsis:
A spirit possesses a vacuum
                                                cleaner, causing many
                                                consequences.

title:
How to Make Millions
                                                      Before Grandma Dies
synopsis:
A man, driven by his desire for
                                                a multi-million dollar
                                                inheritance, begins to care for
                                                his terminally ill grandmother.
                                                However, winning her favor will
                                                not be an easy task and he is
                                                not the only one with an eye on
                                                the money.

title:
Ong-Bak: The Thai
                                                      Warrior
synopsis:
When the head of a statue sacred
                                                to a village is stolen, a young
                                                martial artist goes to the big
                                                city and finds himself taking on
                                                the underworld to retrieve it.

title:
Uncle Boonmee Who Can
                                                      Recall His Past Lives
synopsis:
Dying of kidney disease, a man
                                                spends his last, somber days
                                                with family, including the ghost
                                                of his wife and a forest spirit
                                                who used to be his son, on a
                                                rural northern Thailand farm.

title: Shutter
synopsis:
When Jane and Tun run over a
                                                girl in a car accident, they
                                                speed away immediately from the
                                                crime scene. However, Tun, a
                                                photographer, soon discovers
                                                strange shadows in his photos,
                                                which unsettles them.

title: The Rescue
synopsis:
A chronicle of the enthralling,
                                                against-all-odds story that
                                                transfixed the world in 2018:
                                                the daring rescue of twelve boys
                                                and their coach from deep inside
                                                a flooded cave in Northern
                                                Thailand.

title: The Protector
synopsis:
A young fighter named Kham must
                                                go to Australia to retrieve his
                                                stolen elephant. With the help
                                                of a Thai-born Australian
                                                detective, Kham must take on all
                                                comers, including a gang led by
                                                an evil woman and her two deadly
                                                bodyguards.

title: Bad Genius
synopsis:
Lynn, a brilliant student, after
                                                helping her friends to get the
                                                grades they need, develops the
                                                idea of starting a much bigger
                                                exam-cheating business.

title: Ziam
synopsis:
In a world succumbing to hunger,
                                                a Muay Thai fighter fights off
                                                zombies to save his beloved.

title: Hunger
synopsis:
A woman running her family's
                                                noodle restaurant receives an
                                                invitation to join the
                                                fine-dining industry under the
                                                tutelage of an infamous chef.

title: Chocolate
synopsis:
An autistic girl with powerful
                                                martial art skills looks to
                                                settle her ailing mother's debts
                                                by seeking out the ruthless
                                                gangs that owe her family money.

title: Uranus 2324
synopsis:
Bonded in their youth and
                                                separated by tragedy, an
                                                astronaut and a free diver bend
                                                the laws of space and time in
                                                their efforts to be together
                                                again.

title: Avalon
synopsis:
A long film compiled from sexual
                                                tapes recorded by the directors.
                                                It documents a six-year
                                                relationship in which mutual
                                                trust is being replaced little
                                                by little by isolation and
                                                distance.

title: My Boo
synopsis:
Very Thai and very romantic
                                                story about love between a boy
                                                and a ghost girl.

title: Death Whisperer
synopsis:
After Yak, the elder brother
                                                returned to his hometown, he
                                                must find a way to save his
                                                younger sister from a bizarre
                                                illness that is causing her to
                                                behave differently.

title: Ong Bak 2
synopsis:
A young Thai boxer learns the
                                                skills and inner meaning of
                                                martial arts.

title: Attack 13
synopsis:
Bussaba, a volleyball player who
                                                enjoyed bullying others, was
                                                found dead by hanging in a gym,
                                                causing chaos and horror among
                                                other team members.

title: Ong Bak 3
synopsis:
Continuing from Ong Bak 2's
                                                1440s, Prince Tien fails to
                                                revenge his parents' murder by
                                                the evil new ruler. The beaten
                                                Tien is rescued. Can he bring
                                                peace to the kingdom?

title: Cemetery of Splendor
synopsis:
A group of soldiers in a small
                                                town on the Mekong River in
                                                northern Thailand are struck
                                                with a bizarre sleeping illness.

title:
Syndromes and a
                                                      Century
synopsis:
Story about director Apichatpong
                                                Weerasethakul's parents, who
                                                were both doctors, and the
                                                director's memories about
                                                growing up in the hospital
                                                environment.

title: The Whole Truth
synopsis:
When two siblings stumble on a
                                                strange hole in the wall of
                                                their grandparents' house,
                                                horrifying incidents reveal
                                                sinister secrets about their
                                                family.

title: Kong Tao
synopsis:
The story begins with local
                                                property developer Song
                                                Longchen, who secretly employs
                                                black magic-known as Hexing-to
                                                seize control of valuable land
                                                parcels. His schemes leave
                                                behind a trail of unexplained
                                                deaths, which authorities
                                                dismiss as mere accidents due to
                                                widespread skepticism toward the
                                                supernatural. Thai journalist
                                                Fon, unconvinced by these
                                                explanations, grows determined
                                                to uncover the truth. At the
                                                same time, four young social
                                                media influencers-Chenxin,
                                                Weikang, Potato, and
                                                Weien-travel to a Thai town to
                                                document its unique local
                                                customs. What begins as a
                                                carefree adventure soon turns
                                                sinister when, after returning
                                                home, they are haunted by eerie
                                                and unexplainable events. Their
                                                fears prove tragically real when
                                                Weikang falls victim to the
                                                curse. Seeking answers, Fon
                                                crosses paths with Amin, a local
                                                guide who reveals the group's
                                                plight. She comes to suspect
                                                that the young travelers have
                                                become entangled in black magic
                                                and joins forces with them to
                                                locate the elusive Master Bai,
                                                the only one believed capable of
                                                lifting the curse. But Song
                                                Longchen, preparing to exploit
                                                black magic once more, stands in
                                                their way. He recruits a dark
                                                practitioner, ordering him to
                                                eliminate both Master Bai and
                                                Fon before they expose him.
                                                Though his disciple Ming Ge
                                                warns of grave consequences, the
                                                practitioner forges ahead,
                                                unleashing a battle of black
                                                versus white magic. In the end,
                                                with the courage and
                                                determination of the group, the
                                                dark practitioner is undone by
                                                his own sinister powers,
                                                consumed by the very magic he
                                                sought to control. Set against a
                                                backdrop of cultural discovery,
                                                this supernatural thriller
                                                explores the clash between
                                                ancient beliefs and modern
                                                skepticism, weaving a tale of
                                                intrigue, morality, and the
                                                unseen forces that linger in the
                                                shadows.

title: Death Whisperer 3
synopsis:
After 25 years from the tragedy,
                                                Young Teenager found mystery box
                                                that belong his grandfather ..

title: Phobia
synopsis:
Four chilling tales intertwine:
                                                a teenager's unsettling text
                                                messages, a bullied student's
                                                dark revenge, a camping trip
                                                gone wrong, and a flight
                                                attendant's nightmarish ordeal.
                                                Each story explores fear and the
                                                supernatural.

title: Come and See
synopsis:
The controversial Thai Buddhist
                                                temple "Dhammakaya" is in crisis
                                                as its abbot was charged with
                                                money-laundering and receiving
                                                stolen property. The film
                                                reflects the clash between
                                                politics and faith in modern
                                                Thai society.

title: Death Whisperer 2
synopsis:
In a world shrouded by darkness,
                                                a relentless force seeks
                                                retribution, undeterred by
                                                boundaries or morality

title: Human Resource
synopsis:
Working in HR at a challenging
                                                company, Fren interviews young
                                                new hires and is secretly one
                                                month pregnant, grappling with
                                                the decision to have a child in
                                                difficult circumstances.

title: Born to Fight
synopsis:
A group of athletes helping a
                                                poor village must stop an evil
                                                tyrant and his men from
                                                terrorizing the village.

title: Tropical Malady
synopsis:
A romance between a soldier and
                                                a country boy, wrapped around a
                                                Thai folk-tale involving a
                                                shaman with shape-shifting
                                                abilities.

title:
Last Life in the
                                                      Universe
synopsis:
A suicidal, obsessively
                                                compulsive Japanese librarian is
                                                forced to lie low in Thailand
                                                with a pot-smoking woman coping
                                                with the recent loss of her
                                                sister.

title: One for the Road
synopsis:
Boss, a high-end club owner
                                                living in New York, receives a
                                                call from his estranged best
                                                friend in Thailand, revealing he
                                                has terminal cancer and needs
                                                his help to complete a final
                                                bucket list.

title: Nang Nak
synopsis:
Mak goes home from war and lives
                                                together with his wife and baby
                                                happily until a friend decides
                                                to reveal a secret.

title: Funeral Casino Blues
synopsis:
A Bangkok hotel worker
                                                moonlights as a rental
                                                girlfriend until violence leads
                                                her to bond with a kind barman.
                                                As romance blooms, his dark past
                                                forces them apart. When she
                                                vanishes, he must search for
                                                her-but nothing is what it
                                                seems.

title: My Sex Doll Bodyguard
synopsis:
It all begins when Brick
                                                receives a mysterious package.
                                                Inside the box is "Anna," an
                                                artificial
                                                intelligence-programmed sex doll
                                                that can transform into a human
                                                being.

title: The Stain
synopsis:
One Night, One Stain written
                                                into a lifetime.

title: P
synopsis:
A young Thai woman moves from
                                                her village to Bangkok to earn
                                                money for her sick grandmother's
                                                medicine. Working in a go-go
                                                bar, she uses her inherited
                                                magical powers to survive, but
                                                the dark forces she unleashes
                                                spiral beyond her control.

title: The Lake
synopsis:
A girl finds a strange egg and
                                                brings it back to her village,
                                                only to later realize it was
                                                from a monster. Now a giant
                                                monster emerges from the lake to
                                                search for the egg, destroying
                                                the town and its inhabitants.

title: Home for Rent
synopsis:
Inspired by terrifying true
                                                events. The new tenants of a
                                                house start terrorizing the
                                                owners of the place they rent,
                                                looking for their next prey to
                                                sacrifice.

title:
Food Truck: Stolen
                                                      Love... and Moo Deng
synopsis:
Jake and Bobby, with the art
                                                director by the truck, don't
                                                know their vehicle will force
                                                Mamiew to face his past once
                                                more.

title: Host
synopsis:
At a remote island reform
                                                school, Ing faces strict
                                                obedience rules and a rigid
                                                hierarchy. As strange events
                                                occur, she questions if she's
                                                their victim or cause.

title: My Boo 2
synopsis:
Witness the deep bond between
                                                Joe and Anong, which has been
                                                long-lasting through many
                                                lifetimes and reincarnations.

title: Flat Girls
synopsis:
Police daughters' bond tested in
                                                a heartfelt coming-of-age tale
                                                of love, friendship, and life's
                                                complexities.

title:
Jan Dara: The
                                                      Beginning
synopsis:
In 1930s Thailand, a boy whose
                                                mother died in childbirth faces
                                                a cruel father while navigating
                                                complex relationships with his
                                                stepmother and other women who
                                                shape his coming-of-age journey.

title: Pee Mak
synopsis:
After serving in the war, Mak
                                                invites his four soldier friends
                                                to his home. Upon arrival they
                                                witness the village terrified of
                                                a ghost. The four friends hear
                                                rumors that the ghost is Mak's
                                                wife Nak. Based on Thai
                                                folklore.

title: The Paradise of Thorns
synopsis:
Unmarried gay couple builds
                                                home, durian farm together.
                                                After one partner's accidental
                                                death, his family seizes assets
                                                due to lack of legal marriage
                                                recognition. Surviving partner
                                                fights to reclaim their shared
                                                property and life's work.

title: 4 Tigers
synopsis:
WAR ERUPTS. THE DAY THE BANDITS
                                                UNITE. The heroic tale of the
                                                legendary bandits of the central
                                                region-Bandit Fai, Bandit
                                                Mahesuan, Bandit Bai, and Bandit
                                                Dam-before becoming the great
                                                adversaries of extraordinary
                                                detective Khun Pan.

title: The Forest
synopsis:
A new teacher arrives at a small
                                                village in rural Thailand. He
                                                has just left the monkhood and
                                                has taken a job at the local
                                                school in a quest to discover
                                                life outside the monastery. He
                                                finds that one of his pupils is
                                                a mute girl who is being bullied
                                                by the other children in the
                                                class. Both the teacher and the
                                                girl must face the challenges
                                                and cruelties of the real world.
                                                The girl retreats into a fantasy
                                                world, finding solace in the
                                                forest with a strange wild boy.
                                                The teacher struggles to bring
                                                her back, whilst at the same
                                                time himself questioning the
                                                world of reality. The worlds of
                                                fantasy and reality clash with
                                                tragic consequences.

title: The Seduction Game
synopsis:
A couple shelters an amnesiac
                                                man. The wife begins an affair
                                                with him. His memories surface
                                                during intimacy. She continues
                                                the relationship hoping to
                                                discover where he concealed
                                                money.
